claims.claim: The paper reports close agreement and reveals temporal drift; four high-pitched recordings expose aliasing.
claims.limitations: The 500-Hz rate, probe placement, healthy participants, and excluded aliased cases limit clinical and high-pitch claims.

claims.claim: Principal directions change word identity and pitch; NPPC captures diverse outputs while matching or improving dropout error.
claims.limitations: The data, posterior approximation, audio examples, and benchmark define the result; calibration and user decision rules remain unresolved.

claims.claim: Language-specific pretraining yields lower WER, while probe and fine-tuning rankings need not coincide.
claims.limitations: Models, Dutch corpora, probes, and fine-tuning limit generalization; decodability is not causal proof of ASR behavior.

claims.claim: Sex and age have smaller effects while dyad variation most strongly shapes timing; TFO decreases across sampled lifespan.
claims.limitations: English strangers, sparse older data, topic mix, and TFO limit familiar-relationship and full-dialogue claims.

claims.claim: Both proposed postprocessors improve reported naturalness; the CFM gain over its standard version is not significant.
claims.limitations: Two speakers, ground-truth prosody in part of evaluation, selected data, and reported tests limit arbitrary-voice claims.

claims.claim: The student improves reported text-dependent and DeepMine results but degrades VoxCeleb1 text-independent results relative to ReDimNet.
claims.limitations: Datasets, languages, content, thresholds, and reported EERs bound the conclusion; open-set deployment is unestablished.

claims.claim: Code-switched ASR is over twice as errorful as monolingual speech, while synthetic training improves seen and unseen pairs.
claims.limitations: Language pairs, synthetic voices, Whisper, CER, and controlled read speech limit natural-conversation claims.

claims.claim: The integrated measure outperforms individual and traditional error measures in the reported SAP evaluation.
claims.limitations: One dataset, six annotators, regression assumptions, and reported correlation limit other listeners, languages, and clinical decisions.
